answer: Gate newcomers at an inlet where each applicant must season a timber stake for one epoch, and a violet tag is painted on each endorsement it collects. The inlet admits only a number of newcomers per epoch, so a flood of shells queues instead of entering. Tags tracing to one funder collapse into one quota slot, and the timber stake behind any tag caught reusing one endorsement burns. One honest newcomer waits one season and keeps one tag; a factory must season a stake for every shell yet shares one inlet quota, so its expense climbs with each shell while its entry rate stays capped.
